aboutText: Since 1978, O'Shea Plumbing has provided dependable plumbing services to Keilor and Melbourne's western suburbs. As a family-owned and operated business for over 40 years, we handle everything from emergency repairs to planned renovations with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Our honest, upfront pricing and weekend availability ensure your plumbing needs are met when you need them most.
servicesHeading: What We Do For Keilor Homes & Businesses
servicesText: Our experienced Keilor plumbers offer a full range of services, from emergency drain clearing and leak detection to gas fitting and hot water system installations. We provide reliable, fast solutions for both residential and commercial properties across Melbourne's west.
